phases.note: Adapter maps create/same-version/old-version/successor explicitly; old replay returns the current revoked/superseded head. DecisionTransactionService provides read-only prepare plus sync commit/revoke with actor/grant/scope/source/supersession re-checks.

rankAttention/groupAttention are deterministic over blocking relations, real business deadlines, waiting age and category; question expiry is separate and expired items are not actionable; grouping keeps per-target approval and never merges actors/projects. Eligibility is a pure filter over admitted identity, layer, capabilities, scope, budget and isolation/egress.

Cold-start advice emits none_eligible/only_eligible/operator_default/fixed_rule only; multiple candidates without a rule return needs_operator_choice instead of an invented ranking. No measured history/probability. Confirmation rejects expiry, task/catalog/policy drift, profile admission/identity drift and scope shrink.

Strict review-report/1 parsing; subject/candidate/artifact/contract/base/environment/check/input/reviewer/attempt/isolation/layer checks. sealed_copy proof + capsule digest or native_read_only/legacy proof; no_findings is not machine PASS; human acceptance is never written.

Zero-model consumer covers attention -> eligibility -> advice -> persisted/replayed advice -> confirmation -> frozen subject -> structured mock review -> persisted evidence -> candidate/profile invalidation. InMemoryRoutingEvidence mirrors A's sync append-only port. Real SQL RoutingEvidencePort is NOT_TESTED until A publishes it.
